caption: The drawing depicts a fenced, raised monument area with a large urn situated atop a rectangular pedestal at the center. The pedestal bears the inscription "SACRED TO WASHINGTON." Flanking the pedestal are two draped female figures: the figure on the left holds a staff topped with a liberty cap, and the figure on the right holds a balance scale. The urn and figures stand within a round enclosure bordered by a decorative metal fence with evenly spaced posts. In front of the monument, inside the enclosure, are crossed flags, a shield, a sword, and what appears to be a drum or similar object. The scene is framed by an architectural setting, with two fluted columns visible on the left and right edges of the image and a tiled floor in the foreground. The color palette consists mainly of muted tones, with shades of grey, blue, and beige. The background features light washes, and there are subtle details suggesting foliage outside the enclosure, while the architectural elements are shaded to create a sense of depth.
title: Wall Paper (Fragment)
